mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate near zero percent signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0 percent, it indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market expansion that enhances consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In the early-cycle recovery phase, a housing starts rate below 700 thousand units indicates insufficient demand for residential construction, which correlates with weak consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 700 during early-cycle recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production index below 100 (relative to 2017 base) reflects weak manufacturing and supply chain activity, which suppresses corporate earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 230 (1982-1984=100), it signals elevated inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a CPI index above 230 indicates an active monetary tightening cycle in response to high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases.
